description: Query, organize, and enter data in JianDaoYun. Use natural language to find form records, summarize business progress, generate analyses, and create new records after confirmation.

display.description_en: Jiandaoyun’s no-code platform connector enables users to create enterprise applications through natural-language conversations, build and manage forms and data, process workflow approvals, and query and deeply analyze business data—helping enterprises rapidly achieve AI transformation based on real business data.
display.description_zh: 简道云零代码平台连接器，自然语言对话创建企业应用、沉淀表单、数据、处理流程审批，查询企业业务数据进行深度分析，帮助企业快速基于真实业务数据进行AI改造
examples_en: Show my pending tasks that I have not handled this week.
Find the customers assigned to me who have not yet been followed up.
Summarize incomplete tasks due this week in the project task form and generate a follow-up list grouped by owner.
Find this week's after-sales service tickets, identify recurring issues, and generate a categorized summary.
From these meeting notes, extract the customer name, requirements, estimated amount, and next steps, then enter them into the opportunity follow-up form; ask me to confirm before writing.
examples_zh: 查一下本周我还未处理的待办。
帮我找一下我负责的、还没跟进的客户名单。
汇总项目任务表中本周到期但未完成的任务，按负责人生成催办清单。
查找本周的售后工单，归纳高频问题并生成问题分类汇总。
根据这份会议纪要，提取客户名称、需求、预计金额和下一步动作，填写到商机跟进表；写入前先让我确认。
